name: one-page-portfolio
description: A single-page personal portfolio done well. Verifies that category caps prevent false positives (no nav, breadcrumbs, search, press page, FAQ, or trust badges expected).

expected.notes: Checks that must be not_evaluated (not_applicable_for_category): en.nav.landmark_missing (<=3 pages), en.nav.breadcrumbs_missing, en.nav.site_search_missing, en.nav.related_links_missing, en.trust.signals_missing, ef.corroboration.press_page_missing, fx.content.faq_absent. nap_missing_plain_text is low for portfolios and passes anyway because name and city are present; phone is not required for a Person.
